//site: formUrl: the admission form (no OTP needed: it opens with ?mobile=). Detection uses dummyMobile; booking uses IISM_MOBILE from trackers/.env.
//targets: Course + level pairs to book (regexes on the option text), in priority order. Every batch of each is watched and booked.
//watch: everySeconds between seat checks (each is one parallel round of batch postbacks); backoffSeconds while the site is failing; rebuildMinutes: redo the course -> level walk (picks up newly listed courses). intervalMinutes is only the healthchecks.io timeout.
//book: maxParallel booking tabs (one per course+batch with seats). A tab closes when its batch shows 0 seats for closeAfterZeroChecks checks in a row, or after attemptMinutes.
